method: critic r2: 7 screenshots of each header/hero text box, 950 ms apart across the 6.72 s drone loop (JS on, motion on), served from dist/ on :8961. Background luminance = 90th percentile of the darker 70% of the box's pixels (the white glyphs excluded); ratio = white vs that background. Approximate: glyph antialiasing and the text-shadow are not modelled, and the subtitle is drawn at rgba(255,255,255,.88), so its real ratio is a little lower than shown.
